summary: PyAI for Startups is a $10M program for 200+ startups building with PyAI across speech, agents, translation and compliance. Program terms last updated October 29, 2026 list four tiers: Starter $5,000 (100k Omni + 1k phone minutes), Launch $20,000 (400k Omni + 5k phone minutes), Growth $50,000 (1M Omni + 10k phone minutes), Scale $100,000 (2M Omni + 20k phone minutes); PyAI picks the tier. Until that update the page listed only Launch, Growth and Scale, with 25k/50k/100k phone minutes released in 12 monthly parts. Credits now release in two to four usage-gated tranches (two for Starter/Launch, three for Growth, four for Scale): the first tranche and the full phone allowance land at activation, and each later tranche unlocks after 80% of released AI credit is used. The 12-month term starts at activation; remaining credit and phone allowance expire at its end. Credits are non-cash, non-transferable, non-refundable and tied to one organization. Phone minutes beyond the allowance, phone numbers, SMS, carrier pass-through fees, taxes, items outside the rate card and enterprise add-ons (SSO, BAA, dedicated capacity) bill at published rates. Eligibility: product using PyAI live or launching within six months, working website, under $10M raised, incorporated fewer than seven years ago (or incorporating within 90 days), not a current PyAI customer on an annual or enterprise contract; one award per company, corporate group or product, and prior recipients are ineligible. No card required. Reselling, sublicensing, or sharing capacity, keys or minutes with another company or product forfeits the award.
claim_steps: Apply at pyai.com/startups with company, product, stage, funding, and a demo link, two-minute video, or deck.

Check the legal terms: annual or enterprise-contract customers and prior recipients are excluded. One award per company, corporate group or product; no resale, sublicensing or sharing capacity, keys or minutes with another company or product.
A person reviews within five business days (two via partner VC/accelerator) and assigns the tier: Starter $5K, Launch $20K, Growth $50K or Scale $100K. The requested tier is only a suggestion.
On acceptance, create or sign in to the PyAI account with the application email and verify it. The award binds to one organization; no card is needed.

The first tranche and full phone allowance arrive at activation; later tranches unlock after 80% of released AI credit is used. Remaining credit and minutes expire 12 months after activation. Credits are non-cash, non-transferable and non-refundable.

Budget separately for phone minutes beyond your allowance, phone numbers, SMS, carrier pass-through fees, taxes, anything outside the PyAI rate card, and enterprise add-ons (SSO, BAA, dedicated capacity); these bill at published rates.
